blocks.text: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect personal information submitted through this website, including inquiry forms, booking request forms, contact forms, and other travel-related communications.
Information Collected
Name, email, phone number, travel dates, destination preferences, inquiry details, and related travel request information.
Used For
Responding to inquiries, preparing quotations, planning itineraries, improving services, and handling customer communication.
Quick Overview
We collect only relevant inquiry details
Your data is used for travel service communication
We do not sell your personal information
Third-party providers may access required booking data
You may contact us regarding your information
Website analytics may be used for improvement
Information We Collect

We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when filling out inquiry forms, requesting quotations, booking travel services, subscribing to updates, or contacting us through the website. This may include your name, email address, phone number, travel preferences, group size, travel dates, and any information you choose to share.
How We Use Your Information

We use your information to respond to inquiries, prepare custom travel proposals, communicate package details, provide quotations, manage booking-related communication, improve our website experience, and deliver customer support before and after travel arrangements.
Booking & Supplier Coordination

If you proceed with a booking or request supplier-dependent services, some information may be shared with third-party providers such as hotels, transport operators, guides, park authorities, insurance providers, and payment processors, only to the extent reasonably necessary to provide travel services.
Website Forms & Communication

Information submitted through website forms may be used to contact you by email, phone, or messaging platforms regarding your inquiry, itinerary planning, quotation requests, booking follow-ups, or service updates related to your interest in our travel products.
Analytics & Technical Data

We may automatically collect limited technical information such as browser type, device type, pages visited, time spent on the website, and general usage behavior through cookies, analytics tools, or server logs, for the purpose of improving website performance and user experience.
Cookies

This website may use cookies or similar technologies to enhance functionality, remember user preferences, understand visitor behavior, and improve website usability. By continuing to use the website, you consent to the use of such technologies unless disabled in your browser settings.
Data Protection

We take reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to help protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or misuse. However, no website or online transmission system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Data Retention

We may retain your information for as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry, provide requested services, maintain internal business records, comply with legal obligations, or resolve disputes related to travel services and customer communication.
Third-Party Links

This website may contain links to third-party websites, booking tools, payment gateways, maps, or partner services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, security, or content of those external websites, and their policies may differ from ours.
Your Choices

You may choose not to provide certain personal information, but this may affect our ability to respond fully to your inquiry or provide specific travel planning or booking-related services. You may also contact us regarding the information you have submitted through this website.
Children’s Privacy

This website is not intentionally directed toward children for independent data submission. If personal information relating to minors is provided as part of a family travel inquiry, it should be submitted only by a parent, guardian, or authorized adult traveler.
Policy Updates

We may revise this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any updates will become effective when published on this website. Continued use of the website after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
Privacy Notice
If you have submitted an inquiry and would like clarification regarding the information provided, please contact us through our official website contact channels.
Our Privacy Policy

This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information. We gather personal details, travel preferences, and data on how you interact with our website. Our goal is to ensure your data is handled responsibly and securely.
Data Collection
We collect information you provide directly, such as when you book a trip or create an account.
Data Usage
Your data helps us personalize your experience and improve our services.
Data Security
We use advanced security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access.
Your Rights
You have the right to access, update, and request deletion of your personal information.

Welcome to our website. These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of our travel-related content, inquiry forms, itineraries, destination pages, booking requests, and other services available through this website. By using this website, you agree to these terms and conditions.
Applies To
All website visitors, inquiries, and booking request users
Website Scope
Tours, safaris, custom itineraries, destination content, and travel inquiries
Quick Overview
Use the website lawfully
Package details may change
Inquiries are not confirmed bookings
Travel documents are your responsibility
Third-party services may apply
Liability is limited by law
Acceptance of Terms

By accessing, browsing, or using this website, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with these terms, you should not continue using the website.
Use of the Website

This website is intended to provide travel information, inspiration, package details, destination guidance, and inquiry options for users interested in tours, safaris, and custom travel arrangements. You agree to use this website only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not damage, disable, overburden, or interfere with the website or other users.
No Guaranteed Booking Confirmation

Submitting an inquiry, request form, or booking interest through this website does not constitute a confirmed reservation. All bookings remain subject to availability, operational feasibility, supplier confirmation, pricing validation, and written approval from our team.
Package Information & Pricing

We aim to ensure that package descriptions, travel times, prices, inclusions, exclusions, photos, and itineraries are presented as accurately as possible. However, travel products are dynamic, and information may change due to seasonality, supplier changes, park entry fees, transport conditions, hotel availability, exchange rate fluctuations, or government regulations.
Custom Itineraries

Some tours and safari packages shown on the website are sample itineraries intended for general guidance. Final travel plans may be customized based on travel dates, budget, group size, accommodation preferences, vehicle type, seasonal conditions, and activity availability.
User Responsibilities

You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information when submitting any inquiry or booking request. You are responsible for reviewing all travel details shared with you before making payments or confirming services.
Passports, Visas & Travel Documents

All passengers are responsible for ensuring that they hold valid passports, visas and other travel documents required for their destination and any transit countries. Passengers should ensure that their passport details are correct and that their passport is in good condition and valid for the period required by the destination country and airline. Visa and entry requirements vary depending on the destination, nationality of the traveller and purpose of travel. Passengers are advised to check the latest requirements with the relevant embassy, consulate, immigration authority or airline before travelling. Where a journey involves transit through another country, passengers are responsible for checking whether a transit visa or any additional documentation is required. Passengers are responsible for providing accurate and complete travel documents. Emerald Isle Travels cannot be held responsible for denied boarding, denied entry, delays or additional costs arising from incorrect, incomplete or invalid travel documentation.
Health, Safety & Fitness to Travel

Some tours, safaris, hikes, wildlife experiences, and adventure activities may involve physical exertion, remote locations, changing weather conditions, uneven terrain, or wildlife exposure. Travelers are responsible for ensuring they are medically and physically fit to travel and participate in booked experiences.
Wildlife & Nature Experiences

Wildlife sightings, weather conditions, road conditions, and natural events cannot be guaranteed. Safari and nature experiences depend on environmental and seasonal factors. Images displayed on the website are illustrative and may not represent exact sightings or conditions during your trip.
Our Role & Third-Party Providers

Emerald Isle Travels may arrange travel services provided by third-party suppliers, including airlines, hotels, transportation providers, tour operators and other service providers. The terms and conditions of the relevant supplier may apply to the services included in your booking. Where a service is provided directly by a third-party supplier, the supplier's applicable terms and conditions will apply.
Booking Confirmation

Customers are strongly advised to read the applicable booking terms and conditions before confirming their reservation. A booking will be subject to the payment terms communicated at the time of confirmation. The applicable payment schedule and due dates will be stated in the booking confirmation. Any deposit or payment made may be subject to the applicable airline, hotel, tour operator or other supplier's cancellation and amendment conditions.
Payment

Customers are required to make payments by the agreed due dates stated in their booking confirmation. Failure to make payment by the applicable due date may result in the cancellation of the booking and applicable cancellation or supplier charges may apply. Payment terms applicable to each booking will be communicated to the customer at the time of confirmation.
Changes to Your Booking

Any request to change a confirmed booking must be made in writing. Changes are subject to availability and the terms and conditions of the relevant airline, hotel, tour operator or other service provider. Amendment fees, fare differences or other charges may apply. Some bookings, fares and services may be non-changeable or non-refundable. Any applicable charges will be communicated at the time of the requested change.
Cancellations & Refunds
Cancellation and refund conditions depend on the relevant service provider and the type of booking. Please read our Cancellation Policy alongside the terms provided in your booking confirmation.
Intellectual Property

All website content, including branding, text, design elements, layout structures, itinerary content, icons, images, graphics, downloadable materials, and custom website code, is protected by intellectual property laws unless otherwise stated. No material may be copied, reproduced, republished, or redistributed without prior written permission.
Prohibited Conduct

You must not misuse the website by attempting unauthorized access, introducing malicious code, scraping data, copying protected content, submitting false inquiries, impersonating others, or using the website in any fraudulent, abusive, or unlawful manner.
Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, special, or punitive damages arising out of or related to your use of this website, reliance on website content, booking delays, supplier failures, travel disruptions, force majeure events, or inability to access the website.
Force Majeure

We are not responsible for failure or delay in performing obligations due to events beyond our reasonable control, including natural disasters, severe weather, disease outbreaks, political unrest, border closures, transport disruption, strikes, government restrictions, or wildlife-related operational restrictions.
Privacy & Data Submission

When you submit personal information through this website, you consent to the collection and use of that information for responding to inquiries, preparing itineraries, communicating quotations, and managing travel-related requests, subject to our privacy practices.
External Links

This website may contain links to external websites, maps, booking tools, partner platforms, or social media pages. We provide these for convenience only and do not control or endorse all external content, services, or security practices on those websites.
Changes to These Terms

We reserve the right to modify or update these Terms of Use at any time without prior notice. Updated terms become effective once published on this website. Your continued use of the website after any changes constitutes acceptance of those updated terms.
Travel Insurance

We strongly recommend that customers obtain appropriate travel insurance before travelling. Travel insurance may provide cover for circumstances such as trip cancellation, medical emergencies, baggage loss or delays, subject to the terms and conditions of the insurance policy. Customers should carefully review their insurance coverage to ensure that it meets their individual travel requirements.
Flight Changes

Flight schedules are subject to change by airlines. In the event of a flight cancellation, delay or schedule change, the available options will depend on the airline's applicable terms and conditions. Where we receive information regarding a change from the relevant airline or supplier, we will communicate the information to the customer where reasonably possible. Additional charges may apply depending on the circumstances and the terms of the airline or supplier.
Special Requests & Medical Requirements

Customers should inform Emerald Isle Travels of any special requirements or medical conditions that may affect their travel arrangements at the time of booking. We will communicate such requests to the relevant service provider where applicable. However, special requests are subject to availability and cannot always be guaranteed.
Important Note
For specific travel bookings, quotations, and custom safari arrangements, additional booking terms may apply and will be shared separately before confirmation.

The content on this website is provided for general information, travel inspiration, and inquiry purposes only. While we strive to keep all information accurate and current, travel-related content may change due to factors beyond our control.
Content Scope
Destination pages, tour details, package descriptions, blog content, wildlife content, maps, routes, and travel images.
Please Note
Illustrations, route visuals, and travel examples may not always reflect final confirmed travel arrangements.
Quick Overview
Website information is general and may change
Images may be illustrative
Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed
Travel conditions may vary by season and supplier
External links are outside our control
Final travel terms apply at booking stage
General Information Only

All content on this website is provided for general informational purposes only and should not be interpreted as a guaranteed offer, confirmed booking, legal advice, medical advice, or binding service commitment unless expressly confirmed in writing.
Travel Content May Change

Prices, itineraries, hotel options, transport details, attraction availability, park entry conditions, travel times, visa requirements, and destination information may change without prior notice due to supplier updates, seasonal conditions, or regulatory requirements.
Illustrative Images & Media

Photos, route maps, destination visuals, wildlife images, and promotional graphics on the website may be used for illustrative or inspirational purposes. They may not always represent the exact hotel, route, room type, vehicle, guide, scenery, or wildlife experience available at the time of booking or travel.
Wildlife Sightings

Wildlife experiences are based on natural conditions and cannot be guaranteed. Animal movements, seasonal changes, weather, park regulations, and environmental factors may affect sightings during safari and nature-based travel experiences.
Custom Itinerary Variations

Sample itineraries shown on the website are intended as examples only. Actual travel routes, duration, accommodations, and included activities may vary depending on client preferences, availability, logistics, road conditions, weather, and final booking arrangements.
No Warranty

We make reasonable efforts to keep the website up to date, but we do not warrant that the website will always be uninterrupted, error-free, secure, complete, or free from inaccuracies or temporary service issues.
Our Role & Third-Party Services

Emerald Isle Travels may arrange travel services provided by third-party suppliers, including airlines, hotels, transportation providers, tour operators and other service providers. The terms and conditions of the relevant supplier may apply to the services included in your booking. Where a service is provided directly by a third-party supplier, the supplier's applicable terms and conditions will apply.
External Websites

The website may contain links to third-party websites for convenience. We do not control, maintain, or guarantee the accuracy, privacy, availability, or security of any external site, and use of those external sites is at your own discretion.
Passport, Visa & Travel Document Requirements

All passengers are responsible for ensuring that they hold valid passports, visas and other travel documents required for their destination and any transit countries. Passengers should ensure that their passport details are correct and that their passport is in good condition and valid for the period required by the destination country and airline. Visa and entry requirements vary depending on the destination, nationality of the traveller and purpose of travel. Passengers are advised to check the latest requirements with the relevant embassy, consulate, immigration authority or airline before travelling. Where a journey involves transit through another country, passengers are responsible for checking whether a transit visa or any additional documentation is required. Passengers are responsible for providing accurate and complete travel documents. Emerald Isle Travels cannot be held responsible for denied boarding, denied entry, delays or additional costs arising from incorrect, incomplete or invalid travel documentation.
Health Requirements

Passengers are responsible for checking any health, vaccination or other medical requirements applicable to their destination and transit countries. We recommend consulting a qualified healthcare professional or relevant health authority before travelling, particularly when travelling to destinations where specific vaccinations or health precautions may be required.
Destination-Specific Requirements

Entry, immigration, customs, health and other travel requirements vary by destination and may change from time to time. Customers are responsible for ensuring that they comply with the requirements applicable to their journey, including requirements for transit countries. Customers are advised to check the latest information with the relevant official authorities before travelling.
Limitation of Responsibility

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for losses, delays, inconvenience, disappointment, route changes, missed sightings, schedule changes, supplier failures, or travel disruptions arising from circumstances beyond our reasonable control.
Final Confirmation Matters
Any confirmed booking, quotation, or custom itinerary will be governed by the final terms, pricing, and supplier conditions shared during the booking process.

Here are some of the most common questions travelers ask before planning a safari, holiday, or custom itinerary through our website. These answers are intended to provide general guidance before final booking confirmation.
Topics Covered
Bookings, custom tours, airport transfers, wildlife, documents, payments, travel planning, and itinerary changes.
Need More Help?
You can still contact us directly through the website inquiry form for tailor-made travel support.
Quick Overview
Inquiries are easy and flexible
Most packages can be customized
Airport transfers are commonly available
Wildlife is natural and not guaranteed
Travel documents remain your responsibility
Final prices depend on dates and availability
1. How do I book a travel package?

You can submit an inquiry through the package page or contact form on the website. Our team will review your request and respond with availability, pricing, and next steps. A booking is only confirmed after written confirmation and any required payment steps are completed.
2. Can packages be customized?

Yes. Most travel packages can be customized based on your travel dates, number of travelers, accommodation style, interests, duration, destination preferences, and planned activities. We can also create tailor-made itineraries for couples, families, groups, or private travelers.
3. Do you provide airport transfers?
Yes. Many travel packages include airport pickup and drop-off services, depending on the itinerary and destination. Transfer details will be confirmed during the quotation or booking process.
4. What is the best time to travel?

The best time to travel depends on the destination, weather patterns, wildlife seasons, and the type of experience you want. Our team can recommend the most suitable travel period based on your preferred itinerary and activities.
5. Are wildlife sightings guaranteed?

No. Wildlife sightings depend on natural conditions, animal movement, weather, and seasonal factors. While many parks and safari destinations offer strong viewing opportunities, sightings can never be guaranteed.
6. Do I need travel insurance?

We strongly recommend that customers obtain appropriate travel insurance before travelling. Travel insurance may provide cover for circumstances such as trip cancellation, medical emergencies, baggage loss or delays, subject to the terms and conditions of the insurance policy. Customers should carefully review their insurance coverage to ensure that it meets their individual travel requirements.
7. Are flights included in the packages?

Some packages may include internal transfers or selected transport services, but international or domestic flights are not always included unless clearly stated in the package details or final quotation.
8. What documents do I need for travel?

This depends on your nationality, destination, transit points, and travel activity type. Travelers are responsible for ensuring they have valid passports, visas, permits, vaccination records, and any other required travel documentation before departure.
9. Can I change my itinerary after booking?

Any request to change a confirmed booking must be made in writing. Changes are subject to availability and the terms and conditions of the relevant airline, hotel, tour operator or other service provider. Amendment fees, fare differences or other charges may apply. Some bookings, fares and services may be non-changeable or non-refundable. Any applicable charges will be communicated at the time of the requested change.
10. How are prices confirmed?

Prices are generally confirmed after your requested dates, availability, accommodation options, and service inclusions are checked. Final pricing may vary based on season, group size, room category, transport type, and supplier updates.
11. Do you arrange private tours?
Yes. Private tours, family trips, honeymoon itineraries, safari journeys, and custom multi-day travel plans can be arranged based on your requirements and preferred travel style.
12. How long does it take to get a response?
Response times may vary depending on the complexity of the inquiry and supplier checks, but we aim to reply as soon as possible with relevant travel guidance and next steps.
13. What should I check about my flights before departure?

Customers are advised to check their flight and travel arrangements before departure, as airlines and other suppliers may make changes to schedules or services. Where applicable, customers should follow any reconfirmation or check-in instructions provided by the airline or Emerald Isle Travels.
14. How much time should I allow for airport check-in?

Customers should allow sufficient time for airport check-in, security and immigration procedures. The recommended check-in time may vary depending on the airline, airport and destination. Customers should follow the check-in requirements provided by the relevant airline. Emerald Isle Travels cannot be responsible for missed flights resulting from late arrival at the airport or failure to comply with the airline's check-in requirements.
15. When will I receive my travel documents?

Travel documents such as e-tickets, hotel confirmations, vouchers and other relevant documents will be provided through the agreed communication method once the applicable requirements and payments have been completed. Customers are responsible for checking all travel documents upon receipt and informing Emerald Isle Travels immediately if they identify any errors or discrepancies.
16. How do I tell you about special or medical requirements?

Customers should inform Emerald Isle Travels of any special requirements or medical conditions that may affect their travel arrangements at the time of booking. We will communicate such requests to the relevant service provider where applicable. However, special requests are subject to availability and cannot always be guaranteed.
17. What should I check before travelling?
Before departure, customers are advised to ensure that they have:
A valid passport and required visa, where applicable
All required travel documents
Confirmed flight and accommodation details
Appropriate travel insurance
Any required health documentation or medication
Sufficient funds and the required payment cards
Any additional documents required for their destination
18. What cancellation and refund conditions apply?

Cancellation and refund conditions depend on the terms and conditions of the relevant service provider and the type of booking. Where a refund is approved, the amount and processing time will depend on the applicable supplier's refund policy and the payment method used. Any applicable cancellation charges, administrative fees, supplier charges or bank charges may be deducted from the refundable amount.
Need a Tailor-Made Itinerary?
If your travel plans are unique, use the website inquiry form and share your preferred dates, destinations, number of travelers, and interests so we can prepare a personalized proposal.
